Your teams are using AI. You have no idea who's spending what.

That was my reality until last week.

Engineering on OpenAI. Product on Anthropic. Marketing on Gemini. 

Everyone with their own credit card, their own keys, their own experiments.

No visibility. No control. No audit trail.

Then I found OwlVigil.

It's basically a control plane for your entire AI stack. One dashboard to see every request, every dollar, every model — across every provider.

What I actually use it for:

→ Tracking who's using what (and how much it's costing)
→ Setting budgets so we don't get surprise bills
→ Routing requests to the right model automatically
→ One set of keys instead of managing 5 different providers

No rebuilding our apps. Just a lightweight integration and we had visibility overnight.

It's not flashy. It's just the governance layer every AI-powered team eventually realizes they need.

Pricing starts free. Team plan is $19/mo. Business is $299/mo.

👉 If you're running AI across your org, you need this.
📌 Check it out → https://owlvigil.com/

🔄 Repost if you've ever looked at your AI spend and had no idea where it all went.

Consistency wins on social media. Doing it every week is the hard part.

You know the drill.

You know you need to post. You know consistency matters. But every week, it's the same cycle:

↳ Staring at a blank content calendar
↳ Prompting ChatGPT for caption ideas
↳ Dragging product photos around Canva
↳ Posting whenever you remember
↳ No idea which post actually drove which sale

You spend more time juggling tools than building your brand.

Then I found Cadenzova.

Launched this week on Product Hunt.

It's your AI Growth Coach. It creates a weekly social media strategy, researches competitors, generates platform-specific content, publishes across multiple platforms, and guides you on exactly who to engage with to grow your audience.

Here's what makes it different:

➟ A full week, planned and scheduled on autopilot — Cadenzova plans, creates, and publishes every pin, post, and reel — then learns what actually worked and makes next week smarter
➟ Approval first — nothing publishes without your approval. Review the week once; it generates and schedules everything
➟ Platform-specific content — Pinterest pins, Instagram carousels, talking-avatar reels, X posts, YouTube Shorts. Each adapted for the platform
➟ Gets smarter every week — every Monday, Cadenzova reviews what happened, learns what worked, and proposes a smarter plan for the week ahead
➟ Growth Coach — personalized action plans based on your audience, platforms, and results. Spend 10-20 minutes a day on the highest-impact activities

What this actually means:

✓ Pins, posts, and reels generated on-brand — captions, hashtags, tracked links included
✓ Auto-scheduled at your best-converting times
✓ Every link tracked back to the visit — know which post actually drives sales
✓ Last week's lessons applied automatically to next week
✓ Ask your strategist — share a screenshot of a post worth engaging with. It writes the comment for you

Built for: Shopify & WooCommerce sellers, Etsy & Gumroad creators, SaaS founders, bloggers, authors, and course creators. 

Platforms: Pinterest, Instagram, X, YouTube Shorts, Bluesky. TikTok publishing is in private testing.

Pricing: Starter $9.99/month, Growth $29.99/month, Pro $99/month. Code EARLYACCESS — 20% off for 6 months (first 30 signups).

👉 One tool instead of five. A content calendar that fills itself.
📌 Plan your first week free → https://lnkd.in/gSsNQKFe

🔄 Repost if you've ever spent more time planning social posts than actually building your brand.

—
#SocialMedia #AI #ContentMarketing #Growth #Cadenzova #ProductHunt

Most GEO tools hand you a number. AlpineRank hands you the test.

You know the drill.

You run a GEO audit. You get a number — 72%, 84, "Excellent." But you have no idea how they got there.

Did they test your page against real AI search questions? Did they fail a check and silently count it as a pass? Did they just make up a number that makes you feel good?

Most GEO tools inflate scores. They're in the business of making you feel better, not actually helping you improve.

Then I found 𝗔𝗹𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗥𝗮𝗻𝗸.

Launched this week.

It's the GEO audit tool that shows its work. 25 real AI-search questions scored against your page, 6 technical checks, and an honest "unable to verify" when a check fails — dropped from the average, never counted as a pass.

Free, no account, ~30 seconds.

Here's what makes it different:

➟ 25 real questions from your market — generated from your topic, never from your page. A test written from your own content is one you always pass. Frozen per URL so re-audits compare
➟ Scored, then checked — each question comes back Covered, Partial, or Missing against your actual content. Then 6 technical checks on the page itself
➟ "Unable to verify" is a result, not a failure — when a check fails, it says so and is dropped from the average. We don't quietly score it as a pass
➟ Live citation checks — five of your questions go to Perplexity, and OpenAI on paid plans. We report which answers cited you
➟ Fixes in your language — every gap comes back with paste-ready content in your page's language. No AI-generated numbers your page doesn't support

What this actually means:

✓ See exactly how AI search engines see your page
✓ Know which questions you cover and which you're missing
✓ Understand why a check failed — not just that it failed
✓ Hand the plan to your coding agent — export as a prioritised plan with every fix and acceptance criteria
✓ Track your score over time with saved audits

The methodology is visible in every report. You see which questions we tested, how your page scored on each, and where we couldn't verify something. Inflated scores and false precision are the standing criticism of this category — here is what we do instead.

Free, no account, ~30 seconds. An account saves your audits, tracks your score over time, and unlocks the fixes for every gap.

👉 Give your page a shot at AI search.
📌 Audit a page → https://alpinerank.com/

🔄 Repost if you've ever gotten a GEO score and had no idea how it was calculated.
—

#GEO #SEO #AISearch #ContentMarketing #AlpineRank #ProductHunt
